project.name: 任务日程
project.visualSpecExcerpt: Mobile task schedule day view. Background: #FFFFFF. Top nav: left arrow icon (back), right side blue pill button '+ Add Task' (#5B6BF5, radius ~20px, white bold text). Calendar strip: horizontal row of 7 day columns (Mon-Sun), dates 11-17, day names in uppercase gray 11px, dates in 14px, selected day (Thu 14) has blue circle bg (#5B6BF5) with white text, non-selected days have subtle gray text. Timeline: vertical red-pink line (#D85B6B, ~2px wide) on left side with circular nodes (~10px) at each task. Active/first task node is filled red circle; others are hollow circles with red border. Task cards: large rounded rectangles (~16px radius), each with distinct gradient/pastel background, padded ~16px, containing task title (bold dark text ~16px), time label (right-aligned, medium weight ~13px, gray), and description (regular ~12px, lighter gray). Card 1 (Wireframing, 12:00 PM): warm red-pink gradient bg (#D85B6B → #E87885). Card 2 (UI Design, 1:30 PM): light lavender bg (#E8E6F5). Card 3 (Prototyping, 3:00 PM): warm cream/yellow bg (#FDF6E3). Card 4 (Usability Testing, 3:45 PM): light mint/green bg (#E8F5F0). Card 5 (Meeting, 4:30 PM): light rose/pink bg (#F5E8E8). Typography: Inter or similar modern sans-serif. Spacing: generous padding ~20px horizontal, ~12px between calendar dates, ~16px gap between cards. Cards have subtle shadow (0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)). Overall clean, modern, soft UI with pastel color-coded task cards. Phone frame shown in reference with rounded corners.
project.designRead: mobile app / task management / clean modern / moderate density / avoid generic card walls
